nodes.description: Public mapping of token balances; written by transferFrom, batchSend, _mints and constructor.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances; updated in approve and transferFrom.
Private privileged address set in the constructor; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Private per-address sale counter, incremented unchecked in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private whitelist mapping set to true by _mints; used to bypass the sale condition in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount configured by init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale amount configured by init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address configured by init and enforced in condition.
Private address whitelisted in ensure and settable by the owner through setTradeAddress.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Constant 18 used to scale supply and sale bounds.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist check: returns true for owner, UNI pair or tradeAddress, otherwise requires condition(_from,_value).
Public payable transfer core; performs allowance deduction, ensure check and unchecked balance updates.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit validation using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b (backdoor).
Privileged mint function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists the spender in canSale.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only payable batch transfer; computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it unchecked.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowance.
External caller address; used for ownership checks, allowance owner, minting and transfer origin.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary code in the context of this contract.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath (underflow risk if the prior require is bypassed).
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without SafeMath in batchSend.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ unchecked increment enabling unlimited sale-count growth/overflow.
_from address parameter of transferFrom/ensure/condition.
_to recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom/ensure.
_value amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve/ensure/condition.
_spender parameter of approve.
spender parameter of _mints receiving minted balance.
addedValue parameter of _mints used to overwrite the recipient balance.
saleNum parameter of init written into _saleNum.
token parameter of init used to derive _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init used to derive _maxSale.
_tos address array parameter of batchSend.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress written into tradeAddress.
a target address parameter of delegate used as delegatecall target.
b calldata parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
total = _value * _tos.length computed in batchSend.
Loop index i iterating over _tos in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the _from argument forwarded to transferFrom.
approve() writes allowance owned by the untrusted msg.sender.
msg.sender is required to equal owner before delegate() performs the delegatecall.
msg.sender must be owner or a hardcoded address to mint and whitelist in _mints.
msg.sender must equal owner to configure sale limits in init.
msg.sender must equal owner to execute batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
constructor assigns owner and initial balance from msg.sender.
owner is initialized to msg.sender inside the constructor.
constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
transfer forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from, _to, _value) for whitelist validation.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address via pairFor.
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b), arbitrary code execution in this contract's context.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] unchecked, allowing the sale limit to be exhausted or overflowed.
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the balanceOf state mapping.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the allowance state mapping.
Unchecked batchSend subtraction mutates balanceOf.
Unchecked increment mutates the _onSaleNum state mapping.
_from is compared against owner, tradeAddress, UNI pair and canSale to bypass the sale condition.
_from determines whose allowance and balance are debited in transferFrom.
_from indexes the balance mapping that is decremented unchecked.
_to is the recipient credited in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved in transferFrom.
_value is validated against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition.
_spender is the approved spender in approve.
spender receives the arbitrary minted balance and whitelist flag in _mints.
addedValue is used to overwrite balanceOf[spender] without overflow checks.
saleNum sets the _saleNum cap enforced by condition.
token sets _minSale in init.
maxToken sets _maxSale in init.
_tos provides the recipient list for batchSend.
addr is written into the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
a is the delegatecall target chosen by the owner in delegate().
b is the delegatecall calldata chosen by the owner in delegate().
total = _value * _tos.length is computed unchecked and then subtracted from the caller balance.
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend.
owner is a whitelisted address that short-circuits ensure.
tradeAddress is a whitelisted address that short-circuits ensure.
canSale[_from] whitelists an address inside ensure.
_minSale is compared against _value in condition.
_maxSale is compared against _value in condition.
_saleNum caps the number of sales checked in condition.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum in condition.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a transferFrom parameter whose value flows directly into the balance/allowance mutation core function.
_to is a transferFrom parameter credited inside the same core function.
_value is the amount parameter consumed by transferFrom.
_spender is the only parameter of approve and should be folded into that function node.
spender parameter is written directly into balanceOf/canSale inside _mints.
addedValue parameter is the minted amount consumed by _mints.
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum inside the init function.
token parameter is used to compute _minSale inside init.
maxToken parameter is used to compute _maxSale inside init.
_tos array parameter is iterated inside batchSend.
addr parameter is the sole assigned value in setTradeAddress.
a parameter is the delegatecall target inside delegate.
b parameter is the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
local total feeds the unchecked balanceOf subtraction in batchSend.
local loop index i only drives the batchSend recipient loop.
